notes.title: Coming Along...
notes.notes:
A big thanks to those of you that playtested and sent me the results! There's definitely going to be some quality of life changes coming up, along with some more interesting puzzle elements and environments that I'm excited to add, should be a ton of fun!

Work is continuing at a slow and steady pace, it's just me working on the game for now and I work on it consistently every day. Trying to keep up with all my new ideas is a lot of work!

Here's a look at the starting area for the game: The Market
